$comment: Single source of truth for every colour in the system. src/theme/color.ts imports this, and scripts/verify-contrast.mjs reads this same file. Neither holds a copy. Changing a value here changes both the app and the guard that checks it - which is the entire point: an earlier version of the guard held its own literals, so reverting fgSecondary to the failing #838383 passed the check while shipping 3.79:1 body text.
